items.title: Akai is embracing vibe-coded mods with an open-source MPC
items.excerpt: The MPC Sample Key will be an open-source 37-key take on Akai's budget MPC Sample, with firmware opened so users can vibe-code new instruments and features with AI coding tools.
items.rationale: A major hardware maker opens an MPC's firmware so owners can vibe-code new instruments with AI. That is a concrete product announcement, not more trend commentary like the 10-20 Verge feature. Of the two outlets covering it, The Verge has the fuller report.

items.title: Behringer Kick is a sampler with vibe-coded firmware at its core: Is this really the future we want?
items.excerpt: Behringer's in-development open-source sampler Kick is pitched around AI-generated firmware: 'With AI, even people without programming experience can turn their ideas into new features and firmware.' It also lists an 'AI camera' for gesture control.
items.rationale: A separate product reveal from another company: Behringer's open-source Kick sampler is designed around AI-written firmware and has an AI gesture camera. Together with Akai, it shows AI-moddable firmware becoming a hardware selling point.

items.title: AI takes the stage with BSO musicians in Tod Machover's wild world premiere
items.excerpt: MIT Media Lab composer Tod Machover's 25-minute 'already and not yet' puts 80-plus Boston Symphony Orchestra players in dialogue with a live AI system that responds to each musician's performance.
items.rationale: A major orchestra premieres a work with a live AI system that responds to each of 80+ players in real time. It brings performance and classical music into a pool otherwise full of gear stories, and it was the reserve pick on 10-28.

items.title: Russia's media regulator blocks viral AI-generated song 'You're My Scumbag' on streaming services
items.excerpt: The viral AI-generated song 'Ty moya...' by DJ NARODNII has been blocked on Russian streaming services by the media regulator.
items.rationale: A new regulatory action: a state media regulator ordered a viral AI-generated song off streaming services. It is a fresh angle on AI tracks charting, separate from the platform-labelling stories already published.

items.title: SMEBench: Benchmarking Neural Music Editing with Synthetized MIDI Edits
items.excerpt: A large-scale benchmark of controlled music edits built by modifying symbolic MIDI performances and rendering matched source/target audio, covering twelve instrumentation, articulation and dynamics edit types for evaluating instruction-based neural music editors.
items.rationale: A new benchmark for instruction-based music editing, with 12 controlled edit types built from paired MIDI renders. It gives a standard way to compare AI editors for instrumentation, articulation and dynamics changes. It is a different task from the published MQAScore and MuseBench evaluation papers.
